article-meta.article-title: Archival Dispatch: 30 Master Broadcasts Dated Across This I Believe, Cecil & Sally, Easy Aces, and Aunt Mary
article-meta.kwd-group: This I Believe, Edward R. Murrow, Pearl S. Buck, Alfred Drake, Cecil and Sally, Easy Aces, Jane Ace, Aunt Mary, Original Filenames

sec.title: Batch 40 Forensic Discoveries
sec.p: Batch 40 resolves 30 philosophical essays, early radio comedies, and daytime drama broadcasts: 8 personal statement broadcasts hosted by Edward R. Murrow on ***This I Believe*** (1952–1954, featuring Nobel laureate Pearl S. Buck and Broadway star Alfred Drake), 8 early 1930 transcription discs from ***Cecil and Sally***, 7 classic domestic comedy episodes from Goodman and Jane Ace's ***Easy Aces*** (Spring 1941), and 7 dramatic chapters from the Mutual Don Lee network serial ***Aunt Mary*** (January 1945).
